ev.q: Source: Xu J, Kochanek KD, Murphy SL, Tejada-Vera B. Deaths: final data for 2007.
In 2007, the disparities in life expectancy for males compared with females and for blacks compared with whites were the smallest ever recorded.
Source: Xu J, Kochanek KD, Murphy SL, Tejada-Vera B. Deaths: final data for 2007.
